teaser.en: A leathery-leaved climbing shrub found only on the coast of Kenya and Tanzania.
teaser.sw: Kichaka kinachopanda chenye majani magumu kama ngozi, kinachopatikana tu kwenye pwani ya Kenya na Tanzania.
teaser.dg: Chitsaka chinachokpwera, chenye makodza mafu dza chingo, chinachophahikana pwani ya Kenya na Tanzania tu.

summary.en: *Chikwalakwala* is a climbing shrub of the coastal belt with tough, leathery leaves. Pakia records its name but no uses or meaning.
summary.sw: *Chikwalakwala* ni kichaka kinachopanda cha ukanda wa pwani, chenye majani magumu kama ngozi. Pakia ameandika jina lake lakini si matumizi wala maana yake.
summary.dg: *Chikwalakwala* ni chitsaka chinachokpwera cha seemu ya pwani, chenye makodza magumu, mafu dza chingo. Pakia anaandika dzinare, ela kaandika matumizige wala manage.

about.en: *Dichapetalum arenarium* is a climbing shrub or liana with leathery, elliptic to oval leaves 6 to 11 cm long. Its flowers are small and its fruits are small, hairy drupes, as in other *Dichapetalum*. Several *Dichapetalum* species are highly poisonous to livestock, but there is no such record for this one.
about.sw: *Dichapetalum arenarium* ni kichaka kinachopanda au mtambaaji mkubwa wenye majani magumu kama ngozi, ya umbo la duaradufu hadi yai, yenye urefu wa sm 6 hadi 11. Maua yake ni madogo na matunda yake ni matunda madogo yenye kokwa na manyoya, kama ilivyo kwa *Dichapetalum* nyingine. Spishi kadhaa za *Dichapetalum* ni sumu kali kwa mifugo, lakini hakuna kumbukumbu kama hiyo kwa spishi hii.
about.dg: *Dichapetalum arenarium* ni chitsaka chinachokpwera, au mmea mure wa nyama za muhi unaokpwera mihi, wenye makodza mafu dza chingo ga umbo ra tumbi, garigo marefu chidide au ga duara, ga sentimita 6 hadi 11 kpwa ure. Maruwage ni madide, na matundage ni madide, genye nyere, genye nyama na tembe ngumu ndani, dza ga *Dichapetalum* zanjina. Aina chache za *Dichapetalum* zina sumu kali kpwa mifugo, ela takuna habari dza hiyo kpwa aina ihi.

where.en: It is found only from south-east Kenya to eastern Tanzania and Zanzibar, in the seasonally dry coastal belt. *Arenarium* means 'of sand', suggesting it grows in sandy places.
where.sw: Hupatikana tu kuanzia kusini-mashariki mwa Kenya hadi mashariki mwa Tanzania na Zanzibar, katika ukanda wa pwani wenye ukame wa msimu. *Arenarium* maana yake ni 'wa mchanga', jambo linaloashiria kwamba huota mahali penye mchanga.
where.dg: Chinaphahikana tu kula kusini-mashariki ya Kenya hadi mashariki ya Tanzania na Zanzibar, kpwenye seemu ya pwani inayouma wakati wa kazikazi. *Arenarium* manage ni 'wa mtsanga', na vino vinaonyesa kukala chinamera phatu phenye mtsanga.

names.en: Pakia records the Digo name *chikwalakwala* and lists it among the names that cannot be analysed. No Swahili or English name has been recorded. Its relative *Dichapetalum madagascariense* is *mtobwe*.
names.sw: Pakia ameandika jina la Kidigo *chikwalakwala* na analiorodhesha miongoni mwa majina yasiyoweza kuchambuliwa. Hakuna jina la Kiswahili wala la Kiingereza lililorekodiwa. Jamaa yake *Dichapetalum madagascariense* ni *mtobwe*.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika dzina ra Chidigo *chikwalakwala* na anariika kahi ya madzina gasigoweza kuelezwa manage. Takuna dzina ra Chiswahili wala ra Chingereza ririroandikpwa. Nduguye *Dichapetalum madagascariense* ni *mtobwe*.
